cues: Virtual reality is a computer generated three dimensional world that replaces what you see and hear, so you feel present inside it.
Sensors track your head and hands; the engine draws two images, one per eye, for depth; the headset displays them; you move again.
The loop must close in under about twenty milliseconds, ninety times a second, or the user feels sick.
